summary.text: Bobby Kaufmann is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 82 who has served in the Iowa House since 2013 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning a steel hauling, construction and demolition business and working as a crop and livestock farmer.

paragraphs.text: Bobby Kaufmann was born in Muscatine, Iowa, and graduated from Wilton High School.
His career experience includes owning a steel hauling, construction and demolition business and working as a crop and livestock farmer.
Kaufmann has been affiliated with the Farm Bureau, the National Rifle Association, the Cedar County Historical Society, the Solon Optimist Club and the Cedar County Soldiers Monument Association.
Kaufmann took office in the Iowa House in 2013 and won re-election in District 73 in 2018 over Jodi Clemens and in 2020 over Lonny Pulkrabek.
In the redrawn District 82 he won in 2022 over Clyde Gibson and in 2024 over Phil Wiese.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him as chair of the House Ways and Means Committee and assigned to the Administration and Rules, House Government Oversight, Higher Education, Fiscal, House State Government and Legislative Council committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat James Behrmann in the general election.
